title: Hot Tokens
hints: How many times does each token appear? Which structure answers that in one pass?
You need the k best by (count, then smaller id). Sorting every distinct token works; can you keep only k of them?
Count with a hash map, then keep a min-heap of size k ordered by (count asc, id desc) so the weakest candidate is on top.

wrong.tie_larger_first.cpp: breaks ties by larger token id instead of smaller
wrong.tle_quadratic.cpp: counts with a linear scan per token (quadratic, fails the perf group)
